description: This Java source file defines the ReferenceController class, a Spring MVC controller responsible for handling requests related to reference data such as countries, zones, provinces, and credit card date options in an e-commerce context. It provides endpoints to retrieve province lists, country and zone names, and credit card expiry date options, utilizing various services and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: ReferenceController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller handling reference data endpoints for provinces, countries, zones, and credit card date options in the e-commerce platform.

methods.name: getProvinces
methods.description: Handles POST requests to retrieve a list of zones (provinces) for a given country code and language.

methods.name: countryName
methods.description: Returns the localized country name for a given country code.

methods.name: zoneName
methods.description: Returns the localized zone name for a given zone code.

methods.name: getCreditCardDates
methods.description: Provides a JSON array of upcoming years suitable for credit card expiration date selection.

methods.name: getMonthsOfYear
methods.description: Provides a JSON array of month numbers for use in date selection dropdowns.
